data.description:
## Context

`examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md` teaches explicit bare assignees and offers direct status transition as an alternative to atomic claim. `examples/agent-skills/rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md` describes an unsigned claimability fast fail as a successful review cycle. Tickets comely-craven-apatosaur and stealthful-calmy-erin establish the enforced claim and review behavior. Ticket arid-gutless-myna introduced the inaccurate successful-cycle wording and requires an append-only correction.

## Plan

- Make the implementation skill use atomic `rebar claim` with the conditional identity guidance established by F15.
- Remove direct `transition open in_progress` as a claim alternative.
- State in the brainstorm skill that blocked work defers plan review until it becomes claimable.
- State that unsigned `INDETERMINATE` is not a successful review verdict.
- Preserve dependency order and the prohibition on agent force.
- Append a historical correction to arid-gutless-myna without rewriting its existing record.
- Run focused skill frontmatter, synchronization, and workflow guidance checks.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The implementation skill requires atomic claim for starting work.
- [ ] The implementation skill uses the F15 identity fallback and does not prescribe a bare handle.
- [ ] The brainstorm skill defers review for blocked work until the ticket becomes claimable.
- [ ] The brainstorm skill states that unsigned `INDETERMINATE` is not a successful verdict.
- [ ] Both skills retain dependency-order and no-agent-force guidance.
- [ ] arid-gutless-myna contains an append-only correction that cites the enforced behavior.
- [ ] Focused skill contract checks pass.
data.title: F17 correct packaged agent workflow guidance
